prompt:
WEAPON: Sword of Theseus (테세우스의 검), the sword of Greek myth, wielded in legend by 테세우스. Legend: 아버지 아이게우스가 바위 밑에 묻어 둔 칼. 테세우스는 이것을 찾아 아테네로 갔고, 아리아드네의 실을 따라 미궁의 괴물을 베었다.

WEAPON LOOK (materials and colors; shape; motifs): bronze leaf-blade sword with an ivory hilt and a gold labyrinth guard, bright bronze, ivory and wine-dark red; short and keen; a labyrinth spiral, bull horns and a red thread.

STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and weapon detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.

SUBJECT: A female mecha personification character with Sword of Theseus as her motif — the weapon reimagined as an armored woman: plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry its materials, colors, shape and motifs. She does NOT hold, carry or wield the weapon; the weapon is not in her hands and not a separate object. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

OUTPUT: one dynamic action image that also works as this character’s card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, no foreground occlusion, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). Default stance is a standing, regal, card-ready pose; motion, effects and environment may be dramatic while her design stays fully readable.

IDENTITY (chosen details override the automatic look)
BASE — Facial ethnicity: Mediterranean.
FACE — Eye color: amber.
HAIR — Hair color: silver, independent of ethnicity.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature, no text, no lettering on banners or walls, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs, no limb replaced by a weapon or a blade.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.
